"""Build pinned upstream sampling kernels for the installed GB10 toolchain."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import time
import hashlib

import psutil
import torch
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load

root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V170-nonlocal-raw-v1')
source=next((root/'upstream/deform-source').glob('*/deform_neighbourhood_sampling/csrc'))
files=[source/'deform_nbrhd.cpp',source/'cpu/deform_nbrhd_kernel.cpp',source/'cuda/deform_nbrhd_kernel.cu']
build=root/'compiled-deform-v1';assert not build.exists();build.mkdir()
os.environ['MAX_JOBS']='2';os.environ['TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST']='12.1'
os.nice(10);os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[2:4])
assert psutil.virtual_memory().available>32*2**30
started=time.time()
module=load(name='v170_deform',sources=[str(p) for p in files],extra_cflags=['-O2'],extra_cuda_cflags=['-O2'],
    build_directory=str(build),with_cuda=True,verbose=True)
receipt=dict(status='compiled-pinned-upstream-CPU-and-CUDA-sampling-kernels',owner=dict(pid=os.getpid(),created=psutil.Process().create_time()),
    started_unix_UTC=started,completed_unix_UTC=time.time(),Torch=torch.__version__,Torch_CUDA=torch.version.cuda,architecture='12.1',
    library=dict(path=module.__file__,sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(module.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()),
    sources=[dict(path=str(p),sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for p in files],
    new_neural_forwards=0,source_text=Path(__file__).read_text())
(root/'deform-build-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Built official CPU/CUDA sampling operator in',time.time()-started,'seconds',flush=True)
